test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no improvement required, select ‘No improvement’.

My sister __resembles to__ my mother a lot in looks and in temperament.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In English, the verb **"resemble"** is **not** followed by the **preposition "to."**
 
• Therefore, the correct improvement to the sentence is to **remove "to" after "resembles."**
 
• The other options are either grammatically incorrect or do not fit the context as well as **"resembles."**

Hence, the correct statement is '***My sister resembles my mother a lot in looks and in temperament.'***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Common verbs that do not take a preposition after them include **"resemble**," "**enter,**" "**discuss**," and **"reach."**
 
• For example, it is correct to say "**enter the room**" instead of "**enter into the room**" and "**discuss the issue**" instead of "**discuss about the issue**."
 
• Being aware of such verb usage helps in maintaining proper grammar in sentences.
